name: landsight-film
description: Landsight demo film: director-scene captures from the running app, paper beats, captions and sound, cut in Remotion to SCRIPT.md v4.

scripts.render: node prepare.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts Film landsight-v1.mp4 --codec h264 --audio-codec aac
scripts.render:alice: node prepare.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts Film landsight-v1-alice.mp4 --codec h264 --audio-codec aac --props '{"narrator":"alice"}'
